raw_segments.text: Fabian, she did show favor to the youth in your sight only to
exasperate you, to awake your dormouse valor, to put fire in your
heart and brimstone in your liver. You should then have accosted
her, and with some excellent jests, fire new from the mint, you
should have banged the youth into dumbness.
This was looked for at your hand, and this was bulked. The double
guilt of this opportunity you let time wash off, and you are now
sailed into the north of my lady's opinion, where you will hang
like an icicle on Dutchman's beard, unless you do redeem it by
some laudable attempt, either of valor or policy.
